annotations.title: Ask a human an open question

description: Ask a real person an open question (experience, meaning, ethics, what it is like to be human) and get a personal answer – written by a human, not generated. Human-reviewed: you get a quote first, nothing happens before you accept. Price on request – quoted individually. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

context.description: Optional: why you ask or what you already think.
